name: step_start
description: Start a step: an agent working in a workspace. Returns the step id and next. The step's end arrives in this conversation as an orrery-event of kind step_end.

schema.description: JSON schema of the step's return value

name: step_status
description: Report a step's current state by id. It returns the state only: no return and no check output.

name: step_result
description: Read one part of a step's return by id. With only id it returns the outline: each top-level field with its type and size, no values. With field it returns that field's value, a string as text and anything else as compact JSON; with field and item, one element of that array field, by its id property or 0-based index. A value is cut at limit runes (default and most 4000) and the result names the offset to continue from.

name: step_check
description: Read one check of a step by id and check name: its round, whether it passed, its detail (at most 4000 runes), and a slice of its gate output from the log orrery kept, or from the stored tails when none was kept. The slice is the last lines lines (default 40, at most 80, each cut at 150 runes) before line before, keeping only lines containing match when given; the result names the before to continue from. round defaults to the check's last round. An unknown check is an error naming the step's checks.

name: step_list
description: List the steps this session started, one line each: id, agent, epic, task, end (running while the step runs) and status. It lists each running step and the 20 most recently ended, oldest first, only one epic's when epic is given. The text is at most 4000 bytes; when steps are cut, the earliest go and a first line counts them. Read one step with step_status, step_result or step_check.

name: step_stop
description: Stop a running step by id.

name: step_resume
description: Resume a step a usage limit holds by id.

name: epic_create
description: Create an epic from an accepted contract, named by id; the epic takes that id and the accepted version's words. base is the commit the epic starts from and is optional: omitted, the epic starts at the base that accepting the contract stored, and a named base that differs from it is recorded as a decision. decisions seeds the epic's recorded decisions. workflow names the workflow the epic pins, epic by default. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed. Lint findings come back as warnings: a warning line for each, naming its field and reason, and the epic is still stored. A refusal names the field that failed.

id.description: the id of the accepted contract the epic is made from; the epic takes the same id

base.description: the commit the epic starts from, in the contract's repository; optional: omitted, the epic starts at the base that accepting the contract stored, and a named base that differs from it is recorded as a decision

workflow.description: the workflow the epic pins, read at base: a repository file .orrery/workflows/<name>.yaml, else the built-in of that name; omit it to pin epic

name: epic_get
description: Return a stored epic by id. Without part, it returns the one-screen text summary: its id, title and phase, whether it is paused or why it is parked, its open questions, its task counts by status, and each part with its item count and byte size. With part, it returns that part, one of tasks, turns, decisions, questions, history, contract, workflow, report, task, question, decision and turn. tasks, turns, decisions, questions and history give one line per item, 50 from offset by default, and an offset <n> continues line when items remain past them. task (with task such as T3), question (with question such as Q2), decision (with decision such as DL3) and turn (with turn such as 3) return that item whole as protobuf JSON. contract, workflow, report, task, question, decision and turn return limit runes from offset, 8000 by default, and name the offset that continues when text remains past them.

decision.description: the id of the decision to read, such as DL3: required with part decision, and refused with any other part

id.description: the id of the stored epic

limit.description: the most items of a list part, or runes of a text part or an item, to read: 50 items or 8000 runes when omitted or 0; needs a part

offset.description: the first item of a list part, or the first rune of a text part or an item, to read: 0 when omitted; needs a part

part.description: the part of the epic to read: tasks, turns, decisions, questions or history, one line per item; contract, workflow or report, its text; or task, question, decision or turn, one item. Omit it for the one-screen summary

question.description: the id of the question to read, such as Q2: required with part question, and refused with any other part

task.description: the id of the task to read, such as T3: required with part task, and refused with any other part

turn.description: the number of the turn to read, a positive integer such as 3: required with part turn, and refused with any other part

name: epic_list
description: List the stored epics as summaries: id, repository, title, phase, created and changed.

name: epic_answer
description: Record a decision on an epic. question names the Q<n> the decision answers, and choice names the choice it gives: a declared choice's id, or other, which needs text. A decision with no question is a note, which takes no choice and returns a warning naming the questions still open. A decision id already recorded with the same text returns the stored decision; other text under that id is refused. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed. A note's warning is the acknowledgement's warning line.

text.description: the caller's words: required with choice other, optional with a declared choice

question.description: the Q<n> the answer names; omit for a note

choice.description: the choice the answer gives the question: a declared choice's id, or other; omit for a note

name: epic_follow
description: Return how often the owner took the advice of each question label, across all epics: per label, the answered questions that had a recommendation and how many were answered with it.

name: epic_pause
description: Pause an epic by id, so the planner starts no turn for it and no limit reset resumes it. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed. An epic the owner paused, or paused with no recorded source, is refused; an epic a usage limit paused is accepted and stays paused past the reset.

name: epic_resume
description: Clear the pause of an epic by id, if it is paused, and resume its limited task steps. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed. An epic that is not paused and holds no limited task step is refused. A park stays; epic_retry ends a park.

name: epic_stop
description: Pause an epic by id and stop the step of its running turn. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed. An epic with no running turn is refused, and nothing is stopped, unless it holds its repository's release slot: then the slot is freed, its open release step is stopped if one runs, and the epic is not paused. epic_release resumes a stopped release.

name: epic_retry
description: End the park of an epic by id, so the planner starts its turns again. With node, rerun the parked workflow node of that id under its next attempt instead, which also ends the park. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed. Without node, an epic that is not parked is refused; with node, a node that is not parked is refused.

node.description: the workflow node id whose parked run reruns under its next attempt; omit to end the epic's park

name: epic_kick
description: Kick an epic by id: record text as a decision made by the caller and wake the epic's planner with it at the epic's next plan run. Refused for a paused epic, for a parked epic (epic_retry ends the park first), and for an epic in an ended phase, which takes no kick. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed.

text.description: the caller's words, which the planner reads at the epic's next plan run

name: epic_release
description: Release an epic by id. A stopped release resumes at its first unfinished step, and undoNone names the 1-based positions of undo-none release steps to run again. An epic that ended with gaps is released on the caller's word, logged as a decision made by the caller, so undoNone must be empty for it. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed. Refused unless the release is stopped or the epic ended with gaps, and each position is undo-none.

undoNone.description: the 1-based positions of the undo-none release steps to run again; omit to name none

name: epic_close
description: Close an epic by id as superseded, shipped by hand or abandoned, which ends it. kind names the close; superseded requires by, the epic that replaces it. The close answers the epic's open questions, ends its running turn, node runs and steps, and frees its release slot. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed. Refused for a superseded close without by.

kind.description: the close kind: superseded, shipped or abandoned

by.description: the epic that replaces this one: required for superseded

name: epic_amend
description: Amend the evidence item of a Requirement of an epic by id: requirement names it and item is the whole item it should hold, which must pass the shape check a created epic's items pass. The amendment starts checking: orreryd runs the new item's red at the epic's base and applies the item only when that red is judged not to hold there; a red that holds refuses it and the old item stays. The owner and the epic's steering conversation may change the conclusion and kind. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed.

requirement.description: the id of the Requirement whose evidence item to amend, such as R2

item.description: the evidence item the Requirement should hold in place of its own, in protobuf JSON field names: capture, limit, artifacts, supplied, conclusion, judge, kind and tests

reason.description: why the item is amended, recorded with the amendment

name: epic_escalate
description: Escalate an open question of an epic by id to the owner, with reason, so the owner is notified. An epic's questions, parks included, are its steerer's to answer: the owner is asked one only once it is escalated, or when no session steers the epic. Only the conversation that steers the epic, or the owner, may escalate; a step of the epic is refused, as are an answered, replaced or already escalated question and an empty reason. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed.

id.description: the id of the stored epic

question.description: the Q<n> of the epic's open question to escalate, such as Q2

reason.description: why no one before the owner can answer the question

name: epic_steer
description: Move the steering of an epic by id to the calling conversation, which takes the epic over from the conversation that steers it now. Returns a short acknowledgement, not the stored epic: the epic id, its phase and one line naming what changed. A refusal names why the steering did not move.

name: evidence_run
description: Run an item's evidence at a revision for one phase, red or green. Returns the evidence run. A refusal names the field that failed.

name: evidence_list
description: List an epic's evidence runs.

name: evidence_get
description: Return one artifact of an evidence run by its path, or the run's stdout log when name is omitted, or its stderr log with stderr. UTF-8 bytes come back as numbered text lines: the last lines lines, 40 by default; before pages backward to lines numbered below it; match keeps only lines that contain it. Other bytes come back as base64.

run.description: the id of the evidence run

name.description: the artifact's repository-relative path; omitted for the run's log

stderr.description: read the run's stderr log instead of its stdout log; only without name

lines.description: how many lines to return, 40 by default

before.description: return only lines numbered below this one, to page backward

match.description: return only lines that contain this text

name: contract_accept
description: Accept a stored contract by id, with the owner's words. Returns the stored contract with its versions and states.

id.description: the id of the stored contract to accept

words.description: the words the owner accepts the contract with

name: contract_get
description: Return a stored contract by id, with its versions and state changes, as protobuf JSON.

id.description: the id of the stored contract to read

name: contract_list
description: List the stored contracts as summaries, without their versions or state changes, as protobuf JSON.

name: contract_propose
description: Propose a contract: store the contract in the file at path as version 1 in state proposed, under id, with the words and the file's decisions. The file is one JSON object holding the contract in protobuf JSON field names, plus an optional decisions array. Returns the stored contract with its versions and states. A file that does not read is refused, naming the path.

id.description: the id the new contract takes: the id of the contract in the file

path.description: the contract file: one JSON object holding the contract in protobuf JSON field names, plus an optional decisions array of decisions in protobuf JSON field names

words.description: the words the writer gives with the version

name: contract_reopen
description: Reopen a stored contract by id, moving it back to state proposed, with the words. Returns the stored contract with its versions and states.

id.description: the id of the stored contract to reopen

words.description: the words the contract is reopened with

name: contract_revise
description: Revise a stored contract by id: append the contract in the file at path as a new version, with the words and the file's decisions. The file has the shape contract_propose reads. Returns the stored contract with its versions and states.

id.description: the id of the stored contract to revise

path.description: the contract file the new version is read from, in the shape contract_propose reads

words.description: the words the writer gives with the version

name: contract_set_aside
description: Set a stored contract aside by id, with words. Returns the stored contract with its versions and states.

id.description: the id of the stored contract to set aside

words.description: the words the contract is set aside with

name: cron_list
description: List this session's orrery cron jobs: the jobs CronCreate scheduled through orrery.

name: cron_delete
description: Cancel one of this session's orrery cron jobs by id. Use it instead of CronDelete, which never reaches orrery.

id.description: the id of the cron job to cancel
